Callout.Name: Protest Reported
Callout.Advisory: Around twenty people, no violence reported.

Script.Line: We have a permit to be here and we are not moving.
Nobody has blocked anything. The pavement is clear behind us.
There are two hundred people here and all of them are peaceful. Do not change that.

Lines.Approach: Loud but peaceful so far. Show a presence and keep the road open.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
